source: Actual packaged game, explicit-HWND Windows Graphics Capture

wideFraming.scope: Actual wide-view renderer/capsule bounds projected through the game camera; excludes portrait composition and artistic acceptance.

findings: All sampled wide views retain both characters and feet; numerical audit records no clipped bounds in 3165 actual wide frames.
Movement, overlapping actions, bionic variants, camera changes and facial performances produce different actual poses. Still-frame sampling does not establish full gait or temporal quality.
Required dark-blue Nib tongue is visible at the playful-expression peak. Earlier Nib Shoot forehead spike is absent in the sampled repaired pose.
Nib eyes remain protruding strips, fur is sparse and dark, mouth and garment construction lack concept fidelity.
Krag retains primitive-like facial and body forms, severe raised-arm axillary stretching, unfinished cloth/armor and weak weapon grip.
Krag melee and shooting portraits crop the acting arm/weapon below the HUD. An action-bust view must be reviewed separately from face portraits.
Current sand has finer grain and quieter ridges, but current characters remain below investor quality.
